column1: # Word boundaries of tmp-test/krysar-cs.wav (scripts/fixtures.sh): 25 s of chapter 2 of Krysař by Viktor Dyk,
# read for LibriVox (public domain). Checked by hand on 1 ms wideband spectrograms and the level curve.
# word<TAB>index<TAB>text: what is said, in order.
# onset/offset<TAB>word<TAB>from_s<TAB>to_s<TAB>class: where a word after or before a pause starts or ends.
# join<TAB>word<TAB>from_s<TAB>to_s<TAB>class: between word-1 and word in connected speech, where a cut clips
#   neither: a stop closure, the onset of a fricative, a glottal stop before a vowel.
# class sharp: the sound shows the boundary within the range. soft: vowel, glide or nasal transitions read
#   with the help of the model's own boundaries, so they are reported, not trusted.
